<data_contract name="principals_test_contract">
<allowed_tables>
Only query these tables:
- analytics.orders
- hr.salaries
- raw.audit_log
- sealed.top_secret
</allowed_tables>
<constraints>
Forbidden operations: DELETE, DROP, INSERT, UPDATE

Rules (violations block execution):
- [alice_only_column_block] Demonstrate per-rule allowlist gating a column block.
- [non_intern_column_block] Demonstrate per-rule blocklist scoping a column block.
</constraints>
</data_contract>
